algorithm.name: facecap-inspired-v2-strict
algorithm.note: joint identity, reliable open lower-face correction, batched fixed-ray acceptance, safe Loop prior

neck_prominence.note: 0.7.0 default = continuous_reference with the two-feature reference implementation: reference_feature_A (upper/main) and reference_feature_B (lower/secondary) are measured from the raw anterior geometry on a sigma=8 mm background; one continuous non-negative C2 two-feature field is fitted, positioned proportionally and scaled together to fit protection and the true neck bottom cut. editing_mode=true, geometry_source=reference_driven_appearance, subject_observation_matched=false. manual_edit/observation remain historical/research paths.
neck_prominence.proportional_note: proportional sizing (0.5.7 candidate, tools/run_neck_proportional.py) is available but NOT the default: W10/W_neck and L50/W50 did not meet the project preference on this short-neck template; see docs/NECK_PROPORTIONAL_SCULPT_REPORT.html. amplitude_mm/candidate_amplitudes_mm apply ONLY to --neck-algorithm observation (research path); the default manual_edit size is the fixed 5 mm design.
neck_prominence.continuous_note: the negative reference residual/ring and the separate shoulder islands are never transported; the public default falls back to the unshaped baseline (status skipped) if the reference is missing or the support/guard audit fails, never to the old pitted manual design.
neck_prominence.two_feature_note: feature_B is a broad lower-neck/upper-chest secondary shoulder, not a second identical larynx; it is not named anatomically. The old 0.6.0 single-feature route cut it at y=-125 and could not represent it.
